messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

message.content:
I don’t have access to a live clock, so I can’t tell you the exact minute‑by‑minute time right now.  
However, here’s how you can figure it out:

| Location | Time zone | Current standard/Daylight saving status |
|----------|-----------|----------------------------------------|
| **New York City** | Eastern Standard Time (EST) / Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) | Currently observing daylight savings (UTC−04:00) |

So whatever your local time is, add four hours to get NYC time during DST, or five hours when it's EST.  

If you need an up‑to‑second timestamp, you can check a reliable source such as:
* Your phone/computer’s world clock feature  
* A website like https://worldclock.com/New-York  
* An online API call (`GET http://worldtimeapi.org/api/timezone/America/New_York`) which returns JSON containing `datetime`, `utc_offset`, etc.
